description:
hCAT is by far the best coin to come out of the Helius privacy narrative. It just hasn't been launched properly yet.

Zolana isn't replacing Solana. 

The real narrative is much bigger.

Helius is bringing confidential transactions to Solana. Assets and amounts can be hidden, with additional privacy possible through custom Rings.

Solana is now entering the privacy race alongside Zcash and Monero.

zCAT = Anonymous Cat (Zcash)
hCAT = Confidential Cat (Helius)
